invariants.statement: PF payloads never include PJ preamble.
PJ payloads never include PF preamble.
Client signer count equals PF contractor count or PJ representative count.
areas_count >= 4 never returns AUTO_GENERATABLE.
areas 1/2/3 map to 7/10/15 business days.
OTHER never validates with blank other_media_channel.
LP false never includes CL-2-5-LANDING-PAGE.
LP true includes CL-2-5-LANDING-PAGE and requires quantity >=1.
creatives 0 omits CL-2-6-CREATIVES; >0 includes it.
Academy false omits CL-2-7-ACADEMY; true includes it.
Flowjuris false omits CL-2-8-FLOWJURIS; true includes it.
Valid fidelity is >=3 and <=term.
Renewal term equals original and creates no new fidelity.
Renewal creative quantity equals previous period unless amended.
Renewal Landing Page automatic quantity is zero.
Initial term value equals monthly fee * term exactly in cents.
Partial service uses actual days in relevant calendar month.
Invoice dates never change service start, term, fidelity or implementation target.
Setup exempt => zero and exempt clause only.
Setup charged => BRL 1000 and charged clause only.
Late fine is exactly 10% of overdue installment.
Rendered contracts contain zero unresolved markers.
Same normalized payload + same spec produces same render_hash.
Changing legally relevant input changes render_hash.
No Flowjuris clause contains individual Flowjuris price.
